agreement.agreement/title: Dar El Wasl Service Agreement (Saudi Arabia Courts) — System v2
agreement.agreement/terms:
DAR EL WASL — SERVICE AGREEMENT (SYSTEM v2)
Governing law and jurisdiction: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Saudi courts).

2) Documents and order of precedence
• The official Proposal (PDF) defines the agreed scope, deliverables, service title, and payment schedule.
• If there is any conflict: Proposal controls deliverables/payment plan; Agreement controls delivery terms.

3) Scope of services
• Services may include MISA licensing, Ministry of Commerce CR issuance, ZATCA, GOSI, Qiwa, Muqeem, Mudad, SPL, and related authority submissions.

5) Fees, payment plan, invoices, and receipts
• Overdue payments may pause work; all payments are recorded through official receipts.

6) Government/external fees and VAT
• External fees excluded unless stated; VAT applies if required by Saudi law.

11) Limitation of liability
• Liability capped at total service fees paid under the Proposal.

— End of sample terms —
